To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the network approach, based on the paradigm of the network theory of complex systems, can be applied to biological regulation, that the network approach can be applied in the context of a mesoscopic level statistical mechanical approach, and that the mesoscopic approach is able to rationalize the experimental findings in different contexts.
the network paradigm is a promising metaphor for the study of complex biological systems and that the mesoscopic level of description is essential in this approach.
the statistical mechanics of biological networks is a promising paradigm for the understanding of biological complexity.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing a mesoscopic view for biological systems and we believe that this will be the only way to obtain effective operational views of these systems.
the development of a statistical mechanics approach to the analysis and understanding of biological systems.
the development of a statistical mechanics approach able to connect the molecular level of analysis with the macroscopic behavior of biological systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the mesoscopic level of description is necessary for the understanding of complex biological systems and that the statistical mechanics paradigm is the most promising approach to develop such a description.

the statistical mechanics inspired approach here proposed can be successfully used to describe the behavior of biological systems in terms of the interplay between microscopic level elements and specific effectors.

the statistical mechanics approach to biological systems is not yet mature enough for providing a complete picture but it is definitely promising for providing a useful frame of reference for a better understanding of the complexity of biological systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the network paradigm is a promising way to connect the different time and space scales in biological systems.

the network paradigm can be used for the analysis of biological systems and that it is necessary to develop a statistical mechanics approach able to deal with the non-equilibrium conditions characterizing biological systems.
the mesoscopic view is essential to obtain a general frame for rationalizing the data coming from the high throughput technologies.
The main takeaway from our work is that

a mesoscopic approach based on the network paradigm can be successfully applied to the analysis of different biological systems, ranging from metabolism to immune response, providing a statistical mechanics perspective to biological systems and suggesting that a network approach can be a powerful tool to rationalize the burden of data generated by high throughput technologies.

the statistical mechanics approach to the network paradigm can be a powerful instrument for the development of mesoscopic approaches in biology and medicine, with a special emphasis on the role of specific effectors in regulating collective behavior.

the network approach can provide a general frame of view for biological systems, allowing to rationalize data coming from high throughputs experiments as well as to derive effective operational view on biological systems.
